verdict.rationale: Atlas is a SaaS incorporation and company-admin service with a dashboard (SAFEs, equity, filings), so user-configurable event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only fixed, vendor-defined automatic steps: auto-filing the EIN and 83(b) elections, signature sequencing, share issuance, and filing reminders. These are adjacent built-in behaviors, not user-defined rules that trigger actions on events, so they earn no credit and no evidence shows the capability.
